answer: Remove rounding bonuses from payouts: compute rewards in exact rational units and carry fractional dust forward instead of rounding every account up. If one saffron pigment sale earns a tenth of a coin, ten aliases must still share that tenth, not each collect a one-coin minimum. Auditors can replay the arithmetic and reject any excess. Splitting an account then produces only an echo of the same entitlement; the farmer must earn additional real value rather than harvest rounding errors.
